pr_title: GameEngine: complete ADR 0142 agent benchmark catalog
pr_body:
## Summary

- Complete ADR 0142 GameEngine Agent Benchmark and curated model catalog on current main.
- Preserve the merged ADR 0143 local model residency/resource-control contract while adding explicit loopback installed-model discovery and benchmark evidence.
- Freeze corpus task, workload, model representation, hardware identity, permissions, and work-claim kinds for comparable evidence; keep unavailable telemetry explicit.
- Require retrieved provenance for read-question success and task-specific passed completion gates for write-capable benchmark evidence.
- Keep compatible/unverified models distinct from benchmark-qualified recommendations; never silently download model weights.
- Fit detached AI Studio inside the normal Windows work area so visual validation can inspect the full window.
